title: Underledger
author: klemle
selftext:
[https://textcrawlers.wospacehub.com/](https://textcrawlers.wospacehub.com/)

Underledger is a punishing text based roguelike. Every decision has potential rewards and consequences. Each day a new dungeon is generated with different floors, rooms and themes. The dungeon is a shared instance so players can write warnings to each other, work together on floor objectives, and leave each other gear.

My biggest struggle with this was getting AI to generate interesting encounters. I've run into this in the past that when working for longer creative sets of writing it all comes out very formulaic. That is still a work in progress as I work to fine tune mechanics and tone.

  
Would love feedback on what plays well and what doesn't.
